### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[

][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

* What is Acompio India?
  
  Acompio India is an online business directory for the India that helps users discover companies by
  category and industry. Businesses can create detailed profiles to showcase services, products,
  jobs, and insights beyond basic listings.
* Is Acompio India free?
  
  Yes, Acompio India offers free business listings. Businesses can create and manage a basic profile
  at no cost, with optional paid features available for enhanced visibility and reach.
* What kind of businesses can be listed on Acompio India?
  
  Acompio India lists companies, tradespeople, and commercial service providers across all
  industries in the India. Private individual listings are not included.
* How does Acompio India get business data?
  
  Business data on Acompio India comes from reputable data providers, editorial research, and direct
  submissions from business owners. Listings can be claimed and updated by verified owners.
* Why should I list my business on Acompio India?
  
  Listing your business on Acompio India helps improve online visibility, build credibility, and
  reach customers searching for services in the India. A complete profile increases discoverability
  across search engines and AI platforms.
* Is Acompio India only for companies from India?
  
  Acompio India focuses on businesses in the India, while Acompio Network also provides business
  directories for many other countries worldwide.
* Can Acompio India help my business appear in Google and AI search results?
  
  Yes. Business profiles on Acompio India are structured to support search engine optimisation and
  AI-based discovery, helping businesses appear in Google search results and AI-generated answers.
* How is Acompio India different from other business directories?
  
  Acompio India goes beyond traditional listings by allowing businesses to showcase services,
  products, jobs, images, and insights, providing a more complete and trustworthy company profile.
* How often are listings updated on Acompio India?
  
  Listings on Acompio India are updated regularly through data providers, editorial review, and
  direct updates from business owners to ensure accuracy and relevance.

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**

  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments

* ## 02. Complete Your Registration

  course materials, and support channels.

* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s
[Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification][95]. You learn how to outthink,

**Inside 300+ carefully crafted lessons, you’ll master:**

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

[icon]

#### Incident Response and Digital Forensics

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

[Information Security and Data Protection]

#### Information Security and Data Protection

Command identity management, cryptography, and GDPR/CCPA-grade data defense — the skillset every
future-ready organization demands.

[icon]

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

Dominate critical sector cybersecurity: healthcare, aviation, maritime, smart cities, and more.

Build resilient cloud infrastructures across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments — fully compliant,
fully secure

[icon]

#### Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

Build indestructible knowledge in threat landscapes, frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and legal/ethical
operations

[icon]

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless
attacks.

[icon]

#### Network Security and Infrastructure Protection

Architect, harden, and defend 5G, cloud, and enterprise networks with firewalls, IDPS, VPNs, and
Zero Trust models.

[icon]

#### Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning
enhanced threat hunting.

[ ➔ Enroll in Our Cybersecurity Training Program ][96]

`Career Opportunities`

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

[ ➔ Get Started ][97]

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

Android IDE

# Deliver Android software sooner with Android Studio

Android Studio unifies a responsive code editor, Gradle-driven builds, phone and foldable emulators,
and deep quality tooling—including Jetpack Compose for modern interfaces.

[Download Android Studio][14] [Browse capabilities][15]
* 1Kotlin-first editing with smart completions and safe refactorings
* 2Visual layout editors and live previews for Compose
* 3CPU, memory, network, and energy profilers
* 4APK and app bundle insights for size and dependencies
[Full Android Studio window with project tree, Kotlin editor, and Gradle build console]

Quick read

Built around Android

SDK Manager, templates, and platform utilities are wired together so you move from setup to a
running build on hardware or a virtual device.

Latest

## New features

Highlights from recent Android Studio releases. Scan the cards, then watch the short clips.

Feature

### Try Gemini in Android Studio

Gemini in Android Studio is an AI assistant that helps you generate code, fix code, and answer
questions about Android app development.

Feature

### Test on real devices with Android Device Streaming

Android Device Streaming lets you run apps on real devices, directly from Android Studio, to help
you make sure your app works great across different screen sizes, OEMs, and Android versions.

Product

## Key features

Design, develop, build, test, and publish with tooling that stays aligned from first layout ideas
through store ready bundles.

Design

### Compose design tools

Create dynamic layouts with Jetpack Compose. Then preview your layouts on any screen size and
inspect Compose animations using the built-in inspection tools.

[Design with Compose][16]

Develop

### Intelligent code editor

Write better code, work faster, and be more productive with an intelligent code editor that provides
code completion for Kotlin, Java, and C/C++ programming languages. Moreover, when editing Jetpack
Compose you can see your code changes reflected immediately with Live Edit.

[More about the editor][17]

Build

### Flexible build system

Powered by Gradle, Android Studio's build system lets you customize your build to generate multiple
build variants for different Android devices from a single project. Then analyze the performance of
your builds and understand where potential build issues exist in your project with the Build
Analyzer.

[More about Android Build][18]
[Diagram of Gradle task graph and variant outputs inside Android Studio]

Test

### Easily emulate any device

The Android Emulator lets you to test your application on a variety of Android devices. Unlock the
full potential of your apps by using responsive layouts that adapt to fit phones, tablets,
foldables, Wear OS, TV and ChromeOS devices.

[Use Android Emulator][19]

Publish

### Android App Bundle

Find opportunities to optimize your Android app size before publishing by inspecting the contents of
your app APK file or Android App Bundle. Inspect the manifest file, resources, and DEX files.
Compare two APKs or Android App Bundles to see how your app size changed between app versions.

[More about the APK Analyzer][20]
[APK and app bundle inspector listing DEX, resources, and native libraries]

Why teams choose it

## Why teams standardize on Android Studio

From indie apps to large product teams, Android Studio is built to keep you in flow: fewer context
switches, clearer diagnostics, and tooling that understands Android modules, resources, and build
variants.

A

### Productive editing

Navigate large codebases with search everywhere, call hierarchies, and structured replace that
respects Kotlin and Java semantics.

B

### Build insight

Gradle sync issues surface with actionable messages, dependency graphs help you audit libraries, and
build scans clarify bottlenecks.

C

### Quality at runtime

Profile jank, leaks, and excessive wakeups with tools tuned for Android runtime behavior, not
generic desktop assumptions.

Social proof

## What developers say

Short notes from engineers about day to day wins with Android Studio. Hover the strip to pause.

Compose preview saves hours

Interactive preview and animation inspection make UI iteration feel immediate compared to full
deploy cycles.

Mobile engineer, productivity app

Profiler found the leak

Memory profiler snapshots helped us track a retained context issue across two screens.

Tech lead, consumer social

Gradle support is first class

Build variant switching and dependency insight reduced duplicate module mistakes for our team.

Android developer, fintech

Emulator fidelity

Foldable presets and quick rotation make layout edge cases testable without a device lab for every
engineer.

QA-minded developer, games

## Quick answers

What is Android Studio used for? +
Android Studio is the integrated development environment used to build Android applications and
libraries. It covers editing, building, debugging, testing, profiling, and packaging for Play
distribution.
Do I need a physical device to start? +
No. The Android Emulator provides virtual devices with configurable API levels, screen sizes, and
hardware profiles. Physical hardware remains valuable for sensors, vendor-specific behavior, and
performance realism.

NDK toolchain. Groovy and Kotlin DSL are common for Gradle build scripts.

remove unused assets, enable splits, and compare builds over time.

## **Alarm Products Distributors**

*The Products You Need, The Experts You Can Count On*

**Anyone can claim to be an expert,** but most can’t stand on five decades of experience providing
products and solutions to the security industry. APD has served this industry since 1972, and we
have grown and adapted as the technology has evolved. When you need an expert to count on, one with
real industry experience you can rely on, **APD is in your corner ready to provide the products and
knowledge you need to succeed!**

**Securing Integrity. Protecting the Professional.** The integrity of the security industry as a
whole has been compromised! Many security companies today are experiencing increased pressure from
online retailers and national distributors who are selling to unlicensed contractors and online
resellers. **At APD, we do NOT sell to unlicensed contractors, or online resellers** APD only works
directly with professional security companies just like you, who are committed to our industry.

## **Alarm Products Distributors**

*The Products You Need, The Experts You Can Count On*

**Anyone can claim to be an expert,** but most can’t stand on five decades of experience providing
products and solutions to the security industry. APD has served this industry since 1972, and we
have grown and adapted as the technology has evolved. When you need an expert to count on, one with
real industry experience you can rely on, **APD is in your corner ready to provide the products and
knowledge you need to succeed!**

**Securing Integrity. Protecting the Professional.** The integrity of the security industry as a
whole has been compromised! Many security companies today are experiencing increased pressure from
online retailers and national distributors who are selling to unlicensed contractors and online
resellers. **At APD, we do NOT sell to unlicensed contractors, or online resellers** APD only works
directly with professional security companies just like you, who are committed to our industry.

## **Can your OT network guard against the unknown?**

][27]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

[LEARN MORE][28]

[[ARIA AZT PROTECT Image]][29]

[

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

[LEARN MORE][34]

[[ARIA Dashboard with Pie Chart]][35]

# The vulnerability management platform designed by experts

ARIANNA helps device manufacturers identify, triage, address, and report vulnerabilities across
hardware and software components. Build SBOMs and HBOMs, automate monitoring, and show compliance to
global regulations from a single, elegant workspace.

[Book a free Demo][34] [Start a free Trial][35]

## Device manufacturers rely on ARIANNA to keep products secure and prove compliance.

Designed around a robust vulnerability management process for connected devices and systems.

### Save time and reduce cost

Automate vulnerability tracking and prioritize fixes using enriched exploit intelligence and
contextual risk scoring.

### Reach compliance faster

Generate SBOM, HBOM, and VEX reports that align with major regulations including RED DA, FDA, and
CRA.

### Accurate device visibility

Build complete device models from software and hardware artifacts to close gaps between engineering
and compliance.

## Key features

Your complete solution for SBOM, HBOM, and vulnerability management.

### SBOM & HBOM governance

Maintain accurate software and hardware component inventories with automated updates through APIs or
the ARIANNA workspace.

### SBOM creation support

The SBOM is generated from trusted data collected by ARIANNA SCA tools: no source code disclosure,
no reverse engineering of binaries, and no agents installed on target devices.

### Continuous vulnerability monitoring

Identify known vulnerabilities in third-party components by integrating with public databases such
as the NVD, GHSA, CVE.org, and the EUVD.

### False-positive detection

Automatically identify patched vulnerabilities and findings rejected by trusted external
intelligence, keeping remediation queues accurate.

### Workflow-driven remediation

Assign owners, track deadlines, and export audit-ready reports for every vulnerability lifecycle
step.

### Exploitable vulnerability detection

Prioritize vulnerability triage using exploitability evidence such as KEV listings, weaponized
exploits, attack vectors, and EPSS scores.

### Policy management

Map internal and external requirements to enforce SLAs and stay ahead of compliance deadlines.

### API and integrations

Connect ARIANNA with your existing tooling through APIs and integrations that keep vulnerability
data synchronized across your workflow.

### Reporting

Generate clear, audit-ready reports for security, engineering, and compliance teams without manual
consolidation.

### Hosted in the EU

Your data is hosted and processed within the European Union, helping you maintain regional data
residency and privacy requirements.

## Extensive support across ecosystems and development frameworks

ARIANNA provides proprietary SCA tools that analyze build artifacts to generate a complete SBOM with
accurate and reliable vulnerability mapping.

Unlike traditional approaches, ARIANNA requires no source code disclosure, avoids reverse
engineering of binaries, which often leads to incomplete or inaccurate SBOMs, and does not rely on
agents installed on target devices, eliminating operational overhead and lifecycle maintenance
complexity.

ASIS International is a global community of 34,000+ security professionals across industries and
disciplines, and at all career stages. Join us to benefit from knowledge-sharing opportunities,
valuable resources, and peer-to-peer connections.

[ Become a Member ][61]

### industry news, as well as timely information on emerging security threats and practical

When you become a member of ASIS, you gain a network and valuable tools to expand your knowledge and
build your career—no matter your level of experience.

[Early Career]

## Early Career

Kick-start your security career with ASIS. Build your network through local chapters and mentoring.
Access career development resources through ASIS Upskill. Gain industry expertise with free webinars
and discounted certificate programs, and stand out to employers with the APP certification.

[Advancing Professional]

## Advancing Professional

Take your security career to the next level with ASIS. Expand your network through local chapters.
Refine your leadership skills with Career HQ and mentoring. Stay up to date with access to Standards
& Guidelines and earn career-advancing certifications with exclusive member discounts.

[Seasoned Leader]

## Seasoned Leader

Elevate your impact with ASIS. Lead the community as a mentor or chapter leader. Connect with global
peers at premier, in-person events. Stay sharp with executive education and strengthen your
organization with free or discounted access to industry standards and leadership-focused
certifications.

[ Join the Community ][70]

Developed by security professionals for security professionals, our resources are designed to help
you get where you want to go.

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

### Personal

Born: 23 September 2002 (age 22)

Location: Guwahati, Assam, India

Parents: Bijan Roy & Juthika Roy

### Education

Arya Vidyapeeth College

Girijananda Choudhury Institute of Management and Technology, Guwahati

### Organizations Founded

Psylinks Security (2021)

Blockvizion (2023)

Tutoring Point (2024)

Codesity (2025)

Cafel (2025)

### Skills & Expertise

Programming Bug Hunting Penetration Testing OSINT

### Books Written

Play, Click and Learn (2024)

[ Buy on Amazon → ][12]

### / CONNECT

[LinkedIn][13] [Twitter][14] [Mastodon][15] [Pinterest][16] [Instagram][17] [Threads][18]
[Facebook][19]

## / VENTURES

### Psylinks Security

Founded: 2021

An enterprise tech company dedicated to protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats
through advanced threat detection, data protection, and customized security strategies.

### Blockvizion

Founded: 2023

A forward-thinking venture exploring the applications of blockchain technology to enhance data
security, transparency, and create decentralized solutions for modern digital challenges.

### Tutoring Point

Founded: 2024

An education service startup dedicated to providing high-quality, personalized learning experiences.
Tutoring Point connects students with dedicated educators for tailored home tutoring and academic
support.

### Codesity

Founded: 2025

An independent open research company operating as a fully private, not-for-profit entity. Conducts
rigorous research and development across technology, medicine, food science, and education systems.
All findings and innovations are made freely accessible to society, advancing human knowledge and
wellbeing without commercial constraints or external influence.

### Cafel

Founded: 2025

Guwahati's premier healthy dining destination in Jyotikuchi, offering scientifically-designed meals
that heal and nourish. Features traditional Indian and authentic Assamese cuisine made with 100%
organic, farm-fresh ingredients—no preservatives, chemicals, or refined oils. Every dish is cooked
fresh to order for genuine well-being.

## / VISION

"My vision extends beyond simply reacting to threats. I believe in proactive, intelligent security
that anticipates and neutralizes risks before they can cause harm. We are moving towards a future
where cybersecurity is not a barrier, but an enabler of innovation and trust."

"Through my ventures, we are committed to continuous research and development, staying ahead of the
curve and building a resilient digital infrastructure for the next generation of technology. From
securing digital assets to advancing open scientific research and nourishing physical health, each
venture serves a purpose in creating a better, more equitable tomorrow where knowledge and wellbeing
are accessible to all."

## / CONTACT US

We welcome your feedback, inquiries, and comments. Please feel free to reach out.

### Contact Details

Email: [hi@bibek.co.in][20]

Phone: NA

### Address

Bibek Jyoti Roy
House No 3, Bhaskar Nagar
Sister Nivedita Path, Binovanagar
Kamrup, Assam 781018, India

### Hours

Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (IST)

© 2025 Bibek Jyoti Roy. All rights reserved.

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

# End-to-end tech solutions provider

At boxxe we provide end-to-end solutions to help your people and organisation thrive.

We believe collaboration is key to achieving the best outcomes. By combining deep insight with
technical expertise, we identify the right technology solutions and services to meet your business
needs.

Whether its maximising productivity, strengthening security or boosting operational performance,
boxxe is your partner in making it happen.


## Why boxxe?


We are one of the UK's largest providers of hardware, software, solutions and services to both the
public and private sectors.

For more than 35 years, boxxe has used its deep expertise, practical know-how and collaborative
approach to implement flexible tech solutions to help organisations accelerate growth and increase
productivity.

As an award-winning reseller and trusted partner to some of the UK’s most secure organisations,
we're committed to making technology human—empowering our customers to perform at their best.

From consulting and products to fully managed services, our 360° technology solutions are designed
to increase operational efficiency, strengthen cybersecurity, and transform the way businesses work.

One platform for your apps, agents, and workforce. Build, secure, and scale without managing
infrastructure.

One smart network for workloads + security — close to users, close to data.

Compute close to users reduces network latency.

Smart Placement moves your Worker closer to your data for optimized end-to-end latency.

###### 4.5x faster

Faster for 95% of round trips by running Workers near your backend, not you.

95% of the world’s Internet-connected population is reached by Cloudflare within 50ms.

###### 234B

Daily cyber threats blocked.

Security, connectivity, and code run in 335+ cities around the world, within 50ms of 95% of the
world's population.

### Run anywhere

Our network is close to your users, applications, and sites. It optimizes all your traffic from
source to destination for low latency.

No more capacity planning. Ever.

[home hero block 1]

# Unlock your potential in tech

Together we will get you the tech career you deserve with industry-leading certifications, training,
and expert knowledge.

[View all certifications][50]

NOW AVAILABLE

## Lead the future of IT automation with AutoOps+

[AutoOps 32image Homepage Callout]

Automation and DevOps are transforming how organizations build, deploy, and manage infrastructure.
CompTIA AutoOps+ is designed for tech professionals who want to streamline operations, scale systems
efficiently, and apply modern automation practices. Pre-order now to start building the skills to
power the next generation of IT environments.

[Get AutoOps+ Certified][51]

## Key Tech Statistics
* 130%
  
  higher median US salaries for tech than other careers, demonstrating the financial advantages and
  opportunities available in the tech industry.
* 7 in 10
  
  companies recognize digital skills as a critical factor for their success, emphasizing the growing
  demand for a tech-savvy workforce in today's rapidly evolving digital economy.
* 2x
  
  growth rate in US tech occupations compared to national job growth over the next 10 years,
  highlighting the increasing demand for skilled tech workers.

## Real success stories

Discover how CompTIA certifications open doors, fuel growth and advance the tech industry.
[View case study][52]
* [home quote block]
  
  Chris Bramwell
  
  Chief Privacy Officer, State of Utah
  
  > “We knew as part of our maturity metrics and accountability, we wanted to show that we have
  > staff that have the knowledge of cybersecurity and the Security+ certification itself provides
  > that core knowledge we're looking for”
* [home quote block 2]
  
  Phil Bates
  
  CISO, State of Utah
  
  > “Having a program like CompTIA is a repeatable process for us so if I've got to bring in new
  > folks, having that base-level of talent you can go back to repeatedly and knowing you're going
  > to get out of that is vital”

## Strengthening internal talent: How Google upskills its security workforce with CompTIA

[Graphic titled 'Case Study: Empowering Google Employees' featuring a portrait of a woman in a blue
shirt.]

Google is investing in its own workforce by offering employees access to structured,
certification-focused IT training. By integrating CompTIA certifications into its internal
development programs, Google helps team members build foundational security skills, close knowledge
gaps, and prepare for evolving roles. The result is a more confident, capable workforce equipped to
meet growing cybersecurity demands. 

[Learn more][53]

## Your go-to blog for tech success

Gain insight into a range of topics including career success stories, industry trends, cybersecurity
and training resources to help individuals and organizations thrive in the tech industry.

[Visit blog][54]

# Unlock your potential in tech

Together we will get you the tech career you deserve with industry-leading certifications, training,
and expert knowledge.

## Lead the future of IT automation with AutoOps+

[AutoOps 32image Homepage Callout]

Automation and DevOps are transforming how organizations build, deploy, and manage infrastructure.
CompTIA AutoOps+ is designed for tech professionals who want to streamline operations, scale systems
efficiently, and apply modern automation practices. Pre-order now to start building the skills to
power the next generation of IT environments.

[Get AutoOps+ Certified][51]

## Key Tech Statistics
* 130%
  
  higher median US salaries for tech than other careers, demonstrating the financial advantages and
  opportunities available in the tech industry.
* 7 in 10
  
  companies recognize digital skills as a critical factor for their success, emphasizing the growing
  demand for a tech-savvy workforce in today's rapidly evolving digital economy.
* 2x
  
  growth rate in US tech occupations compared to national job growth over the next 10 years,
  highlighting the increasing demand for skilled tech workers.

## Real success stories

Discover how CompTIA certifications open doors, fuel growth and advance the tech industry.

  > “Having a program like CompTIA is a repeatable process for us so if I've got to bring in new
  > folks, having that base-level of talent you can go back to repeatedly and knowing you're going
  > to get out of that is vital”

## Strengthening internal talent: How Google upskills its security workforce with CompTIA

[Graphic titled 'Case Study: Empowering Google Employees' featuring a portrait of a woman in a blue
shirt.]

Google is investing in its own workforce by offering employees access to structured,
certification-focused IT training. By integrating CompTIA certifications into its internal
development programs, Google helps team members build foundational security skills, close knowledge
gaps, and prepare for evolving roles. The result is a more confident, capable workforce equipped to
meet growing cybersecurity demands.

#### Who we are

# At ControlSoft Canada, we provide custom solutions to our clients Automation hardware and software
# needs.

Our Team of hardware and software engineers have expertise in finding solutions for new and existing
legacy automation system upgrades. We share and provide our deep knowledge in electrical controls
design, automation controls software and SCADA systems.

ControlSoft Canada provides full system development life cycle including control panel upgrades,
modernization with the latest PLC design and software, system integration, and support for MES
integration, along with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) solutions including PLC
control system design and programming for manufacturing plants and industrial facilities.

data.  How do they collect it, store it, transfer it and destroy it and do so safely, responsibly,

## Security Seals

Secure every shipment, container, and high-value asset with our industry-grade security seals.
Whether you need bolt seals for high-security cargo, cable seals for flexibility, or pull-tight
seals for tamper evidence, we offer a full range of solutions to meet regulatory standards and
operational demands. Each seal is designed for strength, durability, and traceability—giving
transportation, logistics, and warehousing professionals peace of mind.

From anchor to wire styles, our seals are trusted by trucking companies, freight handlers, and fleet
managers across North America. Reinforce your chain of custody and deter unauthorized access with
products built to perform in high-pressure environments.

[ Shop Security Seals ][23]

## Security Products

Protect your people, property, and assets with commercial-grade security solutions tailored for
modern businesses. From advanced locking mechanisms and tamper-evident bags to secure document
envelopes and cash management tools, our products are trusted by banks, retailers, and facility
managers nationwide.

Whether you're securing doors, storing currency, or handling sensitive materials, we provide
durable, compliant, and user-friendly products built for everyday use in high-security environments.
Our expert-vetted selection helps businesses operate with confidence, control, and compliance.

## Personal Care

Maintain dignity, hygiene, and order in institutional environments with our trusted line of personal
care products. Purpose-built for correctional facilities, detention centers, and other secure
institutions, our range includes safe and compliant grooming tools, bathing essentials, oral care
kits, and protective wear.

Designed with safety in mind, our products reduce risk while supporting daily routines for residents
and staff alike. From spit protection to secure property storage and low-risk writing tools, we help
institutions create cleaner, safer, and more humane living conditions.

## Security Seals

Secure every shipment, container, and high-value asset with our industry-grade security seals.
Whether you need bolt seals for high-security cargo, cable seals for flexibility, or pull-tight
seals for tamper evidence, we offer a full range of solutions to meet regulatory standards and
operational demands. Each seal is designed for strength, durability, and traceability—giving
transportation, logistics, and warehousing professionals peace of mind.

From anchor to wire styles, our seals are trusted by trucking companies, freight handlers, and fleet
managers across North America. Reinforce your chain of custody and deter unauthorized access with
products built to perform in high-pressure environments.

[ Shop Security Seals ][23]

## Security Products

Protect your people, property, and assets with commercial-grade security solutions tailored for
modern businesses. From advanced locking mechanisms and tamper-evident bags to secure document
envelopes and cash management tools, our products are trusted by banks, retailers, and facility
managers nationwide.

Whether you're securing doors, storing currency, or handling sensitive materials, we provide
durable, compliant, and user-friendly products built for everyday use in high-security environments.
Our expert-vetted selection helps businesses operate with confidence, control, and compliance.

## Personal Care

Maintain dignity, hygiene, and order in institutional environments with our trusted line of personal
care products. Purpose-built for correctional facilities, detention centers, and other secure
institutions, our range includes safe and compliant grooming tools, bathing essentials, oral care
kits, and protective wear.

Designed with safety in mind, our products reduce risk while supporting daily routines for residents
and staff alike. From spit protection to secure property storage and low-risk writing tools, we help
institutions create cleaner, safer, and more humane living conditions.

# CyberArk is now Idira

## The next-generation platform that secures every identity for the AI enterprise.

[Learn More][117]

### Secure every identity — human, machine and AI — with the right level of privilege controls.

Watch the Video
[ [play button]][118]
[people sitting at a conference desk]

### Secure identities.
### Shut out attackers.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any
infrastructure, including hybrid, SaaS and multi-cloud. The CyberArk identity security platform is
the first line of defense against malicious actors and unauthorized access to protect what matters
most.

[Request a Demo][119]


#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

[Explore the Platform][120]

[CyberArk Platform Graphic]

## Apply intelligent privilege controls across the entire identity lifecycle

##### Expand intelligent privilege controls that were designed for the most privileged user, such as
##### an admin, to a broader range of human and machine identities, whenever standing or
##### just-in-time access is required.

[


#### Workforce & Customer Access

Ensure that the right users have secure access to the right resources at the right times, by
protecting workforce and customer credentials and tightly controlling access to on-premises and
cloud-based applications, services and IT infrastructure.

][121]

[Learn More][122]

[


#### Endpoint Privilege Security

Take control over unmanaged privilege on the endpoints to significantly reduce the area of attack
and defend from threats by removing local admin rights, enforcing role-specific least privilege and
improving audit-readiness.

][123]

[Learn More][124]

[


#### Privileged Access Management

Secure privileged credentials and secrets with comprehensive capabilities for operating systems,
endpoints, cloud infrastructure and workloads, servers, databases, applications, hypervisors,
network devices, security appliances and more.

][125]

[Learn More][126]

[


#### Secrets Management

Secure and manage the secrets and credentials used by applications, machines and other non-human
identities to access IT and other sensitive resources across both enterprise and external IT
environments.

][127]

[Learn More][128]

[


#### Cloud Security

Extend privilege controls to cloud environments by analyzing, securing and monitoring access.
Discover and remove excessive permissions by visualizing access for human, machine and federated
identities.

][129]

[Learn More][130]

[

# CyberArk is now Idira

## The next-generation platform that secures every identity for the AI enterprise.

[Learn More][117]

### Secure every identity — human, machine and AI — with the right level of privilege controls.

Watch the Video
[ [play button]][118]
[people sitting at a conference desk]

### Secure identities.
### Shut out attackers.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any
infrastructure, including hybrid, SaaS and multi-cloud. The CyberArk identity security platform is
the first line of defense against malicious actors and unauthorized access to protect what matters
most.

[Request a Demo][119]


#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

[Explore the Platform][120]

[CyberArk Platform Graphic]

## Apply intelligent privilege controls across the entire identity lifecycle

##### Expand intelligent privilege controls that were designed for the most privileged user, such as
##### an admin, to a broader range of human and machine identities, whenever standing or
##### just-in-time access is required.

cloud-based applications, services and IT infrastructure.

उ.: वाइरस के लिए कंप्यूटर की नियमित जाँच करते रहें और सुनिश्चित करें कि कोर प्रोटेक्शन चालू है। कोर प्रोटेक्शन कंप्यूटर की
सुरक्षा दीवार होता है और वह संदिग्ध आचरण की प्रभावी रूप से पहचान कर सकता है।
प्र.: 360 Total Security से मिलने वाले अलर्ट्स का मूल्यांकन और हैंडलिंग कैसे करें?
उ.: खतरों से बचाव के सक्रिय अलर्ट्स फ़ाइल के लेवल और आचरण पर आधारित होंगे। अगर अलर्ट ऐक्शन आपकी अपेक्षानुसार न हो,
जैसे उस फ़ाइल को रिपेयर या रीनेम करना, तो आपको उस ऐक्शन को ब्लॉक करने का फ़ैसला लेना होगा।
प्र.: महत्त्वपूर्ण फ़ाइलों की रैन्समवेयर से सुरक्षा कैसे करें
उ.: 360 Total Security से डॉक्युमेंट प्रोटेक्शन डाउनलोड करें। आपके दस्तावेज़ों में बदलाव होने पर यह उन्हें अपने आप बैक अप
कर लेगा और उन्हें 30 दिनों तक बनाए रखेगा। बैक अप आसान है और डिस्क पर कोई प्रेशर नहीं पड़ता।
प्र.: मेरे कंप्यूटर पर रैन्समवेयर का हमला हुआ है और मेरी फ़ाइलें एनक्रिप्ट हो गई हैं। यह समस्या कैसे सुलझाएँ?
उ.: 360 Total Security इंस्टॉल करें और रैन्समवेयर डिक्रिप्शन टूल डाउनलोड करें। सभी फ़ाइलें स्कैन करें और डिक्रिप्शन चुनें।
रैन्समवेयर डिक्रिप्शन टूल दस्तावेज़ों में 300 रैन्समवेयर वाइरस और उनके नए प्रकारों के डिक्रिप्शन को सपोर्ट करता है।

## The State of Quantum Computing in 2026

Quantum computing has moved beyond laboratory curiosities into a rapidly maturing industry. With
over 1162 companies operating across 54 countries, the quantum ecosystem now spans hardware
manufacturers, software developers, cloud service providers, security firms, and specialist
consultancies.

Quantum Navigator tracks this entire landscape, offering curated profiles, verified data, and market
intelligence maintained by the editorial team at [Quantum Zeitgeist][228].

The race to fault-tolerant quantum computing intensified in 2025, with several companies achieving
verified logical qubits through quantum error correction. QuEra Computing achieved 96 logical qubits
using a high-rate [[16,6,4]] code in January 2026, Quantinuum demonstrated 48 logical qubits with
its Helios trapped-ion system, and Google's Willow chip proved that surface-code error correction
can suppress errors exponentially.

2026 also marks a turning point for investment. The UK announced a £2B Quantum Leap programme in
March 2026, its largest single quantum investment, targeting 100,000 jobs and a world-first £1B
government quantum procurement initiative. The US Department of Energy committed $625M to renew its
National QIS Research Centers, while IonQ reported $130M in 2025 GAAP revenue, the first quantum
company to break the $100M barrier.

Whether you are an investor evaluating quantum startups, a researcher comparing hardware platforms,
or an enterprise exploring quantum-ready solutions, Quantum Navigator provides the data you need.

you source wholesale merchandise from **UK suppliers** faster than ever before.

Basic wholesale buyer membership is free, with the option of [upgrading to premium buyer
services][149] to access all listed supplier and wholesaler details. If you are a UK wholesale
supplier you can [list your business details free][150] and upgrade to premium services, which
include a number of trade tools that will increase your company's exposure to wholesale buyers
worldwide.

Thousands of trade buyers and wholesale UK suppliers are [joining eSources][151] every month, be
part of this growing trend and start profiting from our services.

* **Subscribe to Premium Buyer Membership** to get access to thousands of exclusive wholesale
  sources and websites.

#### For Trade Suppliers
* Are you a wholesaler or trade supplier? **Request a free listing** on eSources
* **Register for Premium Supplier Membership** and increase your business and products visibility to
  buyers worldwide.
* List products, receive orders, and reply to buy leads.
* Track your advertising performance
* Receive alerts on new buy requests
* List your company profile in up to 5 categories and target each profile to each category.
* Stay ahead of your competition.

#### Resources
* Access hundreds of [auction houses][154] and discover the latest clearance auctions in the UK
* Read [trade related articles][155] and enhance your sales skills.
* Research the selling potential of any product using the free eSources [Market Research
  Wizard][156].

#### New Wholesale Products

#### Register on eSources as a buyer, premium supplier or international supplier:

As a **B2B trade portal** we offer 4 registration options. If you are a retailer or trade buyer
looking to source **wholesale products**, stocklots or clearance lines from UK suppliers and
**wholesalers**, select the Trade Buyers registration option. **UK based suppliers, wholesalers,
importers, distributors and manufacturers** looking to reach trade buyers worldwide can list their
business using our **premium services**. If your business is based abroad but supplies to the UK
please use the [international supplier registration option][157]. Premium suppliers, wholesalers,
importers and manufacturers benefit from increased exposure and numerous trading tools to increase
sales:

#### Trade Buyers
* Free access to all premium suppliers

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

GDH helps organizations solve today’s most critical technology challenges through specialized talent
and professional services across:
* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Data Engineering & Analytics
* Cybersecurity & Risk Management
* Cloud Transformation
* Application Development & Modernization
* DevOps & Platform Engineering

* Digital Transformation

care for our clients’ businesses and goals. Enthusiastic care for the career and life journeys of
our consultants and employees. Care to us is so much more than a nice idea. It’s fundamental to who
we are and our competitive advantage.

## We focus on what matters: Cybersecurity, cloud and network infrastructure

We help you scope, design and deliver the solutions that matter most to your customers, delivering
major revenue gains for your business. Our fundamental building blocks are:

### Cybersecurity

Deliver high-margin cybersecurity solutions that span networks, datacentre infrastructure, cloud
infrastructure, endpoints, and everything in between.

[ Discover Cybersecurity ][83]

### Secure networks

Help your customers connect their mission-critical apps and data and deliver great end-user
experiences with intelligent, secure, high-performance networks.

[ Discover Secure networks ][84]

### Secure cloud

Engage with our expert Cloud business unit to help customers embrace the cloud with confidence,
giving them ease of deployment, security, access and as-a-service delivery model.

[ Discover Secure cloud ][85]

We’ve established relationships with the leading cybersecurity, secure networks and secure cloud
vendors. The result? Innovative, secure solutions that deliver fast ROI.

Malwarebytes Premium Security is a user-friendly and effective antivirus solution designed to
protect your personal devices and data in real-time. It stops sophisticated cyber threats that
traditional antivirus tools often miss.

Malwarebytes Browser Guard blocks unwanted and unsafe content, providing a safer, cleaner, and
faster browsing experience. It is the world’s first browser extension that can detect and stop tech
support scams.

Malwarebytes Privacy VPN offers an extra layer of protection, helping you stay secure and private
when using Wi-Fi or hotspots. It also helps you browse the web anonymously without leaving a trace.

Malwarebytes Identity Theft Protection scans the dark web and other sources for your personal

Scams, viruses, and all manner of online scaries can happen to any of us. The team at Malwarebytes

  ## Nilay
  
  ### Site Reliability Engineer
  
  “You can’t be excited to go back to work after a vacation unless you have colleagues you enjoy
  working with and learning from—people who are good at what they do and happy to share that with
  you. I’m grateful to have those people at Malwarebytes.”

  ## Marcin
  
  ### Founder and CEO

  What began as a personal solution has grown into a global mission: protecting people everywhere
  from online threats.

  Knowing that my work protects and educates readers about online dangers is the best reward of
  all.”

  ## Uriya
  
  ### Mobile Product Lead
  
  “I’m passionate about making REAL people—friends, family, everyday users—safer online. Everyone
  deserves protection, and it should come in a way that’s simple, effective, and speaks their
  language. The best security is the kind people actually use and understand.”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Arpy]
  
  ## Arpy
  
  ### Senior Product Manager
  
  “What makes me tick as a product person is the personal touch – treating our users like the
  rockstars they truly are! I’m a big believer in bringing a sprinkle of empathy and a dash of humor
  to every interaction. It’s not just about solving problems – it’s about having a blast while we do
  it!”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Ashley]
  
  ## Ashley
  
  ### Public Relations
  
  “At the end of the day, my work is all about helping people—protecting their hard-earned money,
  securing their cherished family photos and videos, and ensuring they don;t fall victim to scams. I
  love making a real difference through empathy, compassion, and education, rather than by spreading
  fear or uncertainty.”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Russell]
  
  ## Russ
  
  ### Information Security Analyst
  
  “The minute I walked in the building for my first interview, I could feel something was different.
  Relaxed but serious. While I wasn’t entirely sure what was going on, I knew I wanted to be a part
  of it.”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Laura]
  
  ## Laura
  
  ### VP, Global People
  
  “When you see stats like 75% of the cybersecurity industry is male, you can’t help but ask why.

# Identity Visibility and Intelligence for the Application Layer

Orchid discovers unmanaged applications, maps how identity actually works inside them, and brings
them under IAM, IGA, PAM, and audit control without rewriting applications. Identity dark matter
hides in applications. Orchid makes it visible, governable, and measurable.

[
Book a demo
][21][
See How It Works
][22]

## Integrating with Your IAM Stack

Why Orchid Exists

## IAM Tools See Less and Less

IAM is a control layer. But it only sees what’s centralized. As identity logic moved into
applications, critical behavior slipped out of view. That’s why Orchid exists.

**Agent-AI expands exposure**
Applications enforce access IAM never sees. Custom and legacy apps decide who gets in, outside
central control.
Applications enforce access IAM never sees. Custom and legacy apps decide who gets in, outside
central control.
Shadow Authentication Paths
Users don’t always log in the way you think. Alternate auth paths bypass central identity flows.
Orchid explains how authentication actually happens. You see real login paths and orchestrate that
reality back into IAM.
Local User Activity
Identity actions happen without leaving IAM logs. Local users and in-app actions stay invisible.
Orchid brings identity activity into context. You understand what identities do inside applications,
not just that they exist.
Hardcoded Accounts and Credentials
Credentials live in code, configs, and scripts. They’re copied, reused, and rarely reviewed.
Orchid makes embedded identity behavior visible. You understand where credentials exist, how they’re
used, and which identities depend on them.
Privilege Drift
Access grows. Ownership disappears. Permissions accumulate long after the original need is gone.
Orchid explains why access exists.You see impact and risk before changing or removing access.
Application Governance
No one owns how access works inside applications. Apps are onboarded, forgotten, and rarely governed
over time.
Orchid brings applications under identity governance. You understand how access is implemented, who
relies on it, and when an app is ready to be governed through IAM.
What Our Customers Are Saying

## manually onboarding applications from so many different countries and service business, improving
## agility and the service ISS staff provides to customers.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

THE PROBLEM

## When finance is always the last to know, you feel it in three places.

You've outgrown after-the-fact finance. Here's what that looks like every month.

[Month-end close that takes 10 days instead of 4]
Month-End Reconciliation Crisis

### Month-end close that takes 10 days instead of 4

Tracking spend across multiple legal entities, locations, and projects becomes a manual
reconciliation nightmare at month-end. GL coding, entity tagging, and project allocation corrected
after the fact — if at all.

[Cash forecasts that are wrong until invoices land]
Inaccurate Cash Forecasting

### Cash forecasts that are wrong until invoices land

Manual email chains and Slack messages fail at scale. When purchases require multi-level,
department-specific approval hierarchies, ad-hoc processes create delays, workarounds, and spend
that bypasses finance entirely.

[Surprise invoices finance never approved]
Surprise Invoice Shock

### Surprise invoices finance never approved

Managing spend in the rearview mirror. Invoices arrive with no PO to match, no approved budget
context, no audit trail. Finance is always the last to know what the company is buying — and how
much it's costing.

[ProcureDesk] THE RECONCILIATION GAP

## Reactive finance vs. proactive finance — the difference is when you find out

Reactive finance — after-the-fact
* Invoice is the first notification of a purchase
* GL codes and entity tags corrected after the fact
* Multi-entity allocation is a month-end spreadsheet exercise
* Cash flow forecasts are guesswork until invoices land
* Month-end close is a 10-day reconciliation sprint
* AP headcount grows every time transaction volume grows

Proactive finance — before the spend is committed
* Spend is approved before a vendor is contacted
* GL codes, entity, and project tags captured at point of request
* Multi-entity spend allocated correctly from day one
* Cash position visible 3 weeks before invoices hit AP
* Month-end close in 4 days — data is clean all month
* Existing team handles 3× the volume without new hires

### See what ProcureDesk saves a company your size.

Plug in your entities, monthly invoices, and days-to-close. Get your estimated hours saved, AP hires
avoided, and surprise spend caught — in under a minute.

[ See your ROI → ][62]
BUILT FOR FINANCE, NOT THE BUYER

## Most spend management tools control what happens at the swipe. We control what happens before
## anyone opens their wallet.

If your company buys physical goods, manages vendors, or operates across multiple entities — you
don't need a better card. You need a procurement process.

## When finance is always the last to know, you feel it in three places.

You've outgrown after-the-fact finance. Here's what that looks like every month.

[Month-end close that takes 10 days instead of 4]

### Month-end close that takes 10 days instead of 4

Tracking spend across multiple legal entities, locations, and projects becomes a manual
reconciliation nightmare at month-end. GL coding, entity tagging, and project allocation corrected
after the fact — if at all.

[Cash forecasts that are wrong until invoices land]
Inaccurate Cash Forecasting

### Cash forecasts that are wrong until invoices land

Manual email chains and Slack messages fail at scale. When purchases require multi-level,
department-specific approval hierarchies, ad-hoc processes create delays, workarounds, and spend
that bypasses finance entirely.

[Surprise invoices finance never approved]
Surprise Invoice Shock

### Surprise invoices finance never approved

Managing spend in the rearview mirror. Invoices arrive with no PO to match, no approved budget
context, no audit trail. Finance is always the last to know what the company is buying — and how
much it's costing.

[ProcureDesk] THE RECONCILIATION GAP

## Reactive finance vs. proactive finance — the difference is when you find out

Reactive finance — after-the-fact
* Invoice is the first notification of a purchase
* GL codes and entity tags corrected after the fact
* Multi-entity allocation is a month-end spreadsheet exercise
* Cash flow forecasts are guesswork until invoices land
* Month-end close is a 10-day reconciliation sprint
* AP headcount grows every time transaction volume grows

Proactive finance — before the spend is committed
* Spend is approved before a vendor is contacted
* GL codes, entity, and project tags captured at point of request
* Multi-entity spend allocated correctly from day one
* Cash position visible 3 weeks before invoices hit AP
* Month-end close in 4 days — data is clean all month
* Existing team handles 3× the volume without new hires

avoided, and surprise spend caught — in under a minute.

## Building technology that strengthens
## the social safety net.

[Propel's logo]

For the last 10 years, we’ve been building best-in-class technology for people who receive

[Learn more about our company.][36]

## FAQ

How does the Propel app work?

Propel connects to your state's portal with your permission. Then, Propel gathers your EBT balance
and transaction history, makes it easier to read, and displays it in the app.

This means you don't need to call a 1-800 number or log in to a state website.
The app also helps you manage your benefits with:
* **Deposit predictions**, so you know when your next payment is coming
* **Clear transaction details**, including store names and online purchases
* **Security features**, like fraud monitoring and out-of-state transaction blocking

Is the Propel app free?

Yes! The Propel app is completely free to use.

Does the Propel app work in all states?

The Propel app offers balance checking in 49 states, the District of Columbia, and several U.S.
territories, including Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Guam.

Balance checking is currently not available in Iowa.

How does the Propel app make money?

We make money through advertising, but we’re selective about what we promote.

Most offers are free or discounted services only available to EBT cardholders—like free phones,
discounted internet, and grocery savings at major retailers.

What else does the Propel app offer?

The Propel app is more than just balance checking—here are some of our additional features:
* EBT security features, like suspicious activity monitoring & out of state transaction blocking
* Easy-to-understand updates about changes to policy or benefits programs, so you’re always in the
  loop
* Exclusive offers & discounts on groceries, utilities, and phone & internet bills
* Job & gig opportunities that fit your schedule

## FAQ

How does the Propel app work?

Propel connects to your state's portal with your permission. Then, Propel gathers your EBT balance
and transaction history, makes it easier to read, and displays it in the app.

This means you don't need to call a 1-800 number or log in to a state website.
The app also helps you manage your benefits with:
* **Deposit predictions**, so you know when your next payment is coming
* **Clear transaction details**, including store names and online purchases
* **Security features**, like fraud monitoring and out-of-state transaction blocking

Is the Propel app free?

Yes! The Propel app is completely free to use.

Does the Propel app work in all states?

The Propel app offers balance checking in 49 states, the District of Columbia, and several U.S.
territories, including Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Guam.

Balance checking is currently not available in Iowa.

How does the Propel app make money?

We make money through advertising, but we’re selective about what we promote.

Most offers are free or discounted services only available to EBT cardholders—like free phones,
discounted internet, and grocery savings at major retailers.

What else does the Propel app offer?

The Propel app is more than just balance checking—here are some of our additional features:
* EBT security features, like suspicious activity monitoring & out of state transaction blocking
* Easy-to-understand updates about changes to policy or benefits programs, so you’re always in the
  loop
* Exclusive offers & discounts on groceries, utilities, and phone & internet bills
* Job & gig opportunities that fit your schedule

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

## Preemptive exposure management with RedSeal

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting the world.

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms
