## Wir sind Spezialisten für Multi-Access-Systeme und Cloud-Lösungen

### Was sind die Vorteile von Multi-Access-Systemen gegenüber klassischen Sicherheitssystemen?

Multi-Access-Systeme bieten im Vergleich zu klassischen Sicherheitssystemen zahlreiche Vorteile. Sie
ermöglichen eine zentrale und flexible Verwaltung von Zutrittsberechtigungen, wodurch Anpassungen in
Echtzeit vorgenommen werden können. Durch den Einsatz fortschrittlicher Authentifizierungsmethoden
wie biometrischer Erkennung oder mobiler Zugriffsmedien wird die Sicherheit auf ein höheres Niveau
gehoben. Zudem bieten diese Systeme umfassende Reporting- und Analysefunktionen, die detaillierte
Einblicke in Zugriffsaktivitäten und Sicherheitsvorfälle liefern. Darüber hinaus reduzieren sie
durch ihre Skalierbarkeit und Integration mit anderen Sicherheitstechnologien die
Gesamtbetriebskosten und den Verwaltungsaufwand, was sie zu einer kosteneffizienten und
zukunftssicheren Lösung macht.

### Wie können Cloud-Lösungen die Sicherheit der Systeme verbessern?

**Verbesserte Sicherheitsprotokolle:** Sie profitieren von modernen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen wie
Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung und regelmäßigen Updates, die oft über die internen
Möglichkeiten hinausgehen.
**Skalierbare Sicherheitsressourcen:** Die Flexibilität der Cloud ermöglicht es, Sicherheitslösungen
gezielt an die spezifischen Anforderungen und die Größe Ihrer Systeme anzupassen.
**Proaktive Bedrohungserkennung:** Mit ständig aktualisierten Bedrohungsdatenbanken und
KI-gestützten Analysetools können potenzielle Risiken frühzeitig erkannt und effektiv gemanagt
werden.
**Zentralisierte Sicherheitsverwaltung:** Eine zentrale Plattform zur Übersicht und Verwaltung Ihrer
Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ermöglicht eine konsistente und effiziente Sicherheitsstrategie.
**Robuste Backup- und Wiederherstellungslösungen:** Umfassende Backup-Optionen und schnelle
Wiederherstellung garantieren den Schutz und die Wiederherstellung Ihrer Daten im Falle eines
Ausfalls oder Vorfalls.

## Wir sind Spezialisten für Multi-Access-Systeme und Cloud-Lösungen

### Was sind die Vorteile von Multi-Access-Systemen gegenüber klassischen Sicherheitssystemen?

Multi-Access-Systeme bieten im Vergleich zu klassischen Sicherheitssystemen zahlreiche Vorteile. Sie
ermöglichen eine zentrale und flexible Verwaltung von Zutrittsberechtigungen, wodurch Anpassungen in
Echtzeit vorgenommen werden können. Durch den Einsatz fortschrittlicher Authentifizierungsmethoden
wie biometrischer Erkennung oder mobiler Zugriffsmedien wird die Sicherheit auf ein höheres Niveau
gehoben. Zudem bieten diese Systeme umfassende Reporting- und Analysefunktionen, die detaillierte
Einblicke in Zugriffsaktivitäten und Sicherheitsvorfälle liefern. Darüber hinaus reduzieren sie
durch ihre Skalierbarkeit und Integration mit anderen Sicherheitstechnologien die
Gesamtbetriebskosten und den Verwaltungsaufwand, was sie zu einer kosteneffizienten und
zukunftssicheren Lösung macht.

### Wie können Cloud-Lösungen die Sicherheit der Systeme verbessern?

**Verbesserte Sicherheitsprotokolle:** Sie profitieren von modernen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen wie
Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung und regelmäßigen Updates, die oft über die internen
Möglichkeiten hinausgehen.
**Skalierbare Sicherheitsressourcen:** Die Flexibilität der Cloud ermöglicht es, Sicherheitslösungen
gezielt an die spezifischen Anforderungen und die Größe Ihrer Systeme anzupassen.
**Proaktive Bedrohungserkennung:** Mit ständig aktualisierten Bedrohungsdatenbanken und
KI-gestützten Analysetools können potenzielle Risiken frühzeitig erkannt und effektiv gemanagt
werden.
**Zentralisierte Sicherheitsverwaltung:** Eine zentrale Plattform zur Übersicht und Verwaltung Ihrer
Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ermöglicht eine konsistente und effiziente Sicherheitsstrategie.
**Robuste Backup- und Wiederherstellungslösungen:** Umfassende Backup-Optionen und schnelle
Wiederherstellung garantieren den Schutz und die Wiederherstellung Ihrer Daten im Falle eines
Ausfalls oder Vorfalls.

FAQ

## Häufige Fragen

### Was unterscheidet Sie von anderen Errichtern für Sicherheitssysteme aus Deutschland?

Was uns von anderen Errichtern für Sicherheitssysteme** **in Deutschland unterscheidet, ist unsere
umfassende internationale Erfahrung, insbesondere mit US-Unternehmen und unsere erfolgreiche
Umsetzung von Projekten nach globalen Standards. Wir setzen auf bewährte Technologien und Produkte
renommierter Hersteller wie Genetec, Lenel, Avigilon und Brivo. Unsere Zertifizierungen nach ISO
9001, DIN 14675 und VDS 3403 sowie unsere Präqualifizierung garantieren höchste Qualität und
Sicherheit. Mit über 20 Jahren Erfahrung und einem Team von hochqualifizierten Fachkräften, bieten
wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und kombinieren schnelle Entscheidungswege mit strukturierten
Prozessen, um anspruchsvolle Sicherheitslösungen effektiv und präzise zu realisieren.

### Wieso sind Sie der richtige Errichter für Sicherheitssysteme für Unternehmen aus den USA in
### Deutschland?

Als Errichter für Sicherheitssysteme für Unternehmen aus den USA, die Produktionsstätten,
Bürogebäude, Lagerhäuser oder andere Einrichtungen in Deutschland betreiben, bieten wir umfassende
Expertise in der Implementierung und Integration führender Sicherheitslösungen von bevorzugten
Herstellern wie Genetec, Lenel, Avigilon und Brivo. Diese Anbieter sind weltweit anerkannt für ihre
hochentwickelten Systeme im Bereich Sicherheitsmanagement für Gebäude. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf
die Einhaltung aller relevanten Regularien und Sicherheitsstandards. Durch die erfolgreiche
Durchführung mehrerer Projekte für amerikanische Unternehmen haben wir ein tiefes Verständnis für
die spezifischen Anforderungen und regulatorischen Vorgaben. Dies ermöglicht uns, passende Lösungen
zu liefern, die sowohl die hohen Erwartungen unserer Kunden erfüllen als auch alle notwendigen
Compliance-Vorgaben sicherstellen.

### Wie läuft der Integrationsprozess eines neuen Sicherheitssystems ab?

**Planung:** In dieser Phase analysieren wir Ihre spezifischen Sicherheitsbedürfnisse und entwickeln
ein maßgeschneidertes Konzept. Wir berücksichtigen alle relevanten Faktoren, einschließlich
bestehender Infrastruktur und gesetzlicher Anforderungen, um eine umfassende und effektive Lösung zu
entwerfen.
**Ausführung:** Nach der Genehmigung des Plans beginnen wir mit der Implementierung des Systems.
Unser Team sorgt für die reibungslose Installation der Hardware und die Konfiguration der Software,
wobei wir höchste Standards für Qualität und Sicherheit einhalten. Während dieser Phase führen wir
auch umfassende Tests durch, um die Funktionalität und Integration in Ihre bestehende Infrastruktur
sicherzustellen.
**Service:** Nach der erfolgreichen Integration bieten wir fortlaufenden Support und Wartung an.
Dies umfasst regelmäßige Überprüfungen, Updates und schnelle Reaktionen auf eventuelle Probleme, um
die langfristige Leistungsfähigkeit und Sicherheit des Systems zu gewährleisten.

### Bieten Sie Schulungen für die Nutzung Ihrer Sicherheitssysteme an?

Ja, wir bieten gezielte Schulungen für die Nutzung unserer Sicherheitssysteme an. Diese Schulungen
sind darauf ausgelegt, Ihre Mitarbeiter in der effektiven Bedienung und Verwaltung der installierten
Technologien zu schulen, um höchste Sicherheit und Effizienz zu gewährleisten. Unsere
Trainingsprogramme werden individuell auf die Bedürfnisse Ihres Unternehmens abgestimmt und können
sowohl vor Ort als auch online durchgeführt werden.

### Wie stellen Sie die Datensicherheit und den Schutz von Kundeninformationen sicher?

Wir stellen die Datensicherheit und den Schutz Ihrer Informationen durch strenge
Datenschutzrichtlinien, verschlüsselte Kommunikation und regelmäßige Audits sicher. Unser Fokus
liegt auf der Einhaltung aller relevanten Datenschutzgesetze und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung
unserer Sicherheitsprozesse, um Ihre Daten jederzeit zuverlässig zu schützen.

### Wie unterstützt uns Ihr Unternehmen, die neuesten Sicherheitsstandards einzuhalten?

Unser Unternehmen unterstützt Sie bei der Einhaltung der neuesten Sicherheitsstandards durch
regelmäßige Beratung, proaktive Updates und Schulungen. Wir stellen sicher, dass alle eingesetzten
Technologien und Prozesse stets den aktuellen regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen, damit Ihr
Unternehmen jederzeit konform mit den geltenden Standards und Best Practices bleibt.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises

**Brian Lacroix** *President*
**Brian Lacroix** *President*

Brian joined Setronics in 2002 as a Field Service Technician quickly distinguishing himself through
his strong commitment to customer service and his ability to creatively design security system
solutions. Throughout his tenure with Setronics, Brian has played a key role in engineering a wide
range of customized integrated security solutions, each successfully deployed at major retail
conglomerates among other industries. This led to Brian’s promotion of Project Engineer in 2006. In
2010 Brian was promoted to Vice President of Engineering where he led a cross-functional team that
designed, engineered and implemented a multi-phase IP migration project for a Fortune 500 retailer.
He was also instrumental in identifying potential business partner ventures to expand on Setronics’
industry expertise which led the company to its first business acquisition in 2012. In recognition
of Brian’s drive to grow Setronics’ core competencies and his ongoing commitment to delivering
security solutions that exceed customer expectations, Brian was promoted to President in April 2013.
Brian holds an Electrical Engineering degree from Northeastern University, Massachusetts’s
electrical licenses, as well as various certificates from industry manufacturers.

**Mike Salvas** *Chief Financial Officer*
**Mike Salvas** *Chief Financial Officer*

Mike joined Setronics in 2021.  He is a CPA with over 25 years of financial experience across a
variety of industries. He began his career at a large national Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT)
in Alexandria, VA where he earned his CPA.  From there, he moved to Boston and worked for another
REIT with offices and properties around the globe.  In addition to Boston, he spent a lot of time in
Chicago and San Francisco working on highly complicated joint ventures.  More recently, he was a
senior financial executive at a telecommunications company.  He brings to Setronics financial
leadership gained from both large international public companies as well as smaller privately owned
businesses.  His diverse background and experience in field service operations and management will
help Setronics to continue to deliver first class installations and support to its customers.

**Jim Bryant** *Vice President of Operations*
**Jim Bryant** *Vice President of Operations*

Jim brings Setronics over twenty-five years of retail management experience in the field of Loss
Prevention and Asset Protection where he managed 80 retail locations with combined sales of $1.6B.
During Jim’s tenure in the  retail industry he partnered with Setronics in the development of a
patent-pending theft deterrent technology. Jim was also a customer of Setronics for nearly 20 years
which piqued his interest into joining the service side of the physical security industry. Jim joins
our team as a Business Development Executive to build & maintain close client  relations as well as
generate positive sales growth. Jim prides himself on his ability to foster long-term client
relationships, which are based on the shared values of quality, integrity and trust. Jim holds
multiple certifications  including: Loss Prevention, Wicklander & Zulawski Interview and
Interrogation, Reid Interview and Interrogation, National Association of Drug Divergence
Investigators and Management of Aggressive Behavior.

## Testimonials

What clients are saying

Our camera system is a very valuable tool that many people in this company use in its day to day
operations.  We have Setronics camera banks in our dispatch office, maintenance facility, and all of
our key people can log on to the system from any computer at any time.  Over the last five years our
cameras have allowed us to correct a lot of bad behavior that we were unaware of before.  Being able
to show an employee video footage has allowed us to correct a wide range of issues ranging from SOP
violations, up to serious safety violations and accidents.  We’ve also used footage to modify best
practices and to apply corrective actions when necessary.  I can sincerely say that I couldn’t
imagine this company operating today without our Setronics camera system.

Over the last five years I’ve had the opportunity to develop a great working relationship with Paul
Ziemba, and the Setronics sales and service team.  Paul is very knowledgeable and his suggestions on
design, hardware, and its placement have been invaluable to us.  Sales and service have also been
great, all of my dealings with them have been efficient and they were always very professional on
site.  In closing I’d like to say that I’d highly recommend the Setronics team to any company that
thinks that they could benefit in any way from their products and service.  We definitely have.

pleasure doing business with a company like yours.

I never realized how useful a camera system could be until we had it up and running.  I personally
find myself using them to keep an eye on my production floor when I’m working remotely.  With them
spread throughout the shop the way you designed the system it makes it easy to see everything that
is going on whether I’m here in person or not.  Our operations manager has found them quite useful
for verifying counts whenever customers call citing a discrepancy.  He was even able to prove that
some damage to a customer’s parts wasn’t done by us as we could see the damage on the frame as it
was unloaded from the customer’s truck!  HR has also found them useful when investigating incidents
that have occurred over the years.  Overall, I’m very glad we made the investment in this camera
system.  I’ll be sure to reach out to you anytime I have a need.  Take care!

President

When my current Supervisor requested any suggestions for CCTV installation and maintenance, your

**Brian Lacroix** *President*
**Brian Lacroix** *President*

Brian joined Setronics in 2002 as a Field Service Technician quickly distinguishing himself through
his strong commitment to customer service and his ability to creatively design security system
solutions. Throughout his tenure with Setronics, Brian has played a key role in engineering a wide
range of customized integrated security solutions, each successfully deployed at major retail
conglomerates among other industries. This led to Brian’s promotion of Project Engineer in 2006. In
2010 Brian was promoted to Vice President of Engineering where he led a cross-functional team that
designed, engineered and implemented a multi-phase IP migration project for a Fortune 500 retailer.
He was also instrumental in identifying potential business partner ventures to expand on Setronics’
industry expertise which led the company to its first business acquisition in 2012. In recognition
of Brian’s drive to grow Setronics’ core competencies and his ongoing commitment to delivering
security solutions that exceed customer expectations, Brian was promoted to President in April 2013.
Brian holds an Electrical Engineering degree from Northeastern University, Massachusetts’s
electrical licenses, as well as various certificates from industry manufacturers.

**Mike Salvas** *Chief Financial Officer*
**Mike Salvas** *Chief Financial Officer*

Mike joined Setronics in 2021.  He is a CPA with over 25 years of financial experience across a
variety of industries. He began his career at a large national Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT)
in Alexandria, VA where he earned his CPA.  From there, he moved to Boston and worked for another
REIT with offices and properties around the globe.  In addition to Boston, he spent a lot of time in
Chicago and San Francisco working on highly complicated joint ventures.  More recently, he was a
senior financial executive at a telecommunications company.  He brings to Setronics financial
leadership gained from both large international public companies as well as smaller privately owned
businesses.  His diverse background and experience in field service operations and management will
help Setronics to continue to deliver first class installations and support to its customers.

**Jim Bryant** *Vice President of Operations*
**Jim Bryant** *Vice President of Operations*

Jim brings Setronics over twenty-five years of retail management experience in the field of Loss
Prevention and Asset Protection where he managed 80 retail locations with combined sales of $1.6B.
During Jim’s tenure in the  retail industry he partnered with Setronics in the development of a
patent-pending theft deterrent technology. Jim was also a customer of Setronics for nearly 20 years
which piqued his interest into joining the service side of the physical security industry. Jim joins
our team as a Business Development Executive to build & maintain close client  relations as well as
generate positive sales growth. Jim prides himself on his ability to foster long-term client
relationships, which are based on the shared values of quality, integrity and trust. Jim holds
multiple certifications  including: Loss Prevention, Wicklander & Zulawski Interview and
Interrogation, Reid Interview and Interrogation, National Association of Drug Divergence
Investigators and Management of Aggressive Behavior.

Gather Requirements

### Start with a Site Survey

Project success is directly linked to the quality of this first step in the security system design
process. Get the site walk right and the rest is easier. Drag-and-drop predefined element icons,
take photos and capture key details.  Photos will automatically be associated to the floor plan and
security devices. The old way took hours and led to mistakes – you’re already way ahead of the game!

**Benefits: **
1. **Mobile tablet app** to take into the field for site surveys.
2. **Easily import floor plans** or create a floor plan, set the scale and start designing. 
3. **Drag-and-drop devices into place** for low-voltage, security, CCTV, access control, intrusion,
   IT, and more.
4. **Capture photos** that automatically associate to floor plans and devices.
5. **Access manufacturer products** to automate a bill of materials.

Design Clean Up

### Fine Tune Designs Back at the Office

After the site survey in the field, synchronize to the cloud and access your Site and Surveys from a
web browser to refine the security system design, select products and accessories. You’ll automate a
bill of materials and reports or proposal. 

Not sure if you have the right security system design? Invite a team member or a partner to
collaborate directly in the design. It’s so much more efficient and accurate than emailing PDFs back
and forth. 

**Benefits: **
1. **Take info gathered at the site survey and refine the security system design **back at the
   office in no time.
2. **Access all the details and photos in one place** associated with your survey and devices.
3. **Cut time in half for a decision-ready design and proposal**.

Share and Collaborate

### Invite Your Team, Partners and Customers to Collaborate

In the past, this meant emailing PDFs back and forth and marking them up by hand. With System
Surveyor, share security system designs easily and securely and invite collaborators. Use the Survey
Comments feature to ask questions about mounts or device placement. Streamline the security system
design process for time and accuracy like never before.

**Benefits: **
1. **Invite your team, customers, vendor partners and subcontractors **directly into the design.
2. **Accelerate design** with the experts from your team and manufacturer partners.
3. **Engage subcontractors** more effectively for install and implementation.
4. **Send a link for fast sharing **with read-only or full privileges. 

Create Reports and Proposals

### Automate Branded Reports, Security System Designs and a BOM

While you have been conducting the site survey and refining the design, you’ve also been automating
reports! 

**Benefits: **
1. **Add your logo to reports and designs** to include with professional proposals or documentation.
2. **Export pre-packaged PDF and Excel reports **including a Bill of Materials.
3. **Get reports with devices, details, and accessories** for life-cycle management
4. **Run critical date reports** for maintenance and inspections.

Accelerate Installs

### Streamline Sales-to-Installation Handoff & Align Your Team

### Give every team member & stakeholder access to surveys, floor plans, photos and project details.

**Benefits: **
1. **System Surveyor Phone app** gives install teams access to all survey & project details. 
2. **Reduce installation time and rework **due to miscommunication.
3. **Update status and photos **during installation and implementation to close the loop.
4. **Accelerate time **from project award to successful, profitable installation.
5. **Get to Lifecycle Maintenance: **Go from install to maintaining, inspecting and upgrading
   systems.

focused.

standards of security.

Our newest certification, ISO 42001, positions TSi at the forefront of responsible and transparent
AI management.

Together, these certifications validate not only our systems and processes, but the culture of
accountability and ownership that drives our success as a 100 percent employee owned company.

These certifications are your guarantee that not only are we the most committed security integrator,
but also the most qualified.

# Intelligence-led Cyber Resilience

##### Operational threat intelligence and automated AI-powered threat
##### detection and response to address the evolving threat landscape

[Take a Product Tour][160] [Request a Demo][161] [Explore Our Platform][162]

NEW: Data Protection for AI Risk

Don't let the pace of AI innovation outrun your security posture.

[Learn More][163]

Evaluate your organization's readiness to manage AI-related data risks.

CyberThreat Report

Trellix intelligence connects signals and contextualizes data across security controls to
anticipate, prepare for, and prevent attacks.

+

### Operational Threat Intelligence

AI-driven ecosystem optimizes workflows to accelerate and scale customer capacity to investigate,
respond to, and recover from incidents.

+

### Automated AI-powered Detection and Response

Trellix unifies protection across complex on-premises, air-gapped, cloud, and operational technology
environments for organizations at all stages of maturity.

+

### Unified Protection for Customer Ecosystems

Resiliency in architecture, management, and operations across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud.

+

### Resilient by Design Architecture

###### Trellix delivers **intelligence-led cyber resilience for the most security-conscious

###### across endpoint, network, data, email, and third parties correlate signals and data access
###### across the environment to detect and respond to threats.

#### Search Tips


**Be concise and specific:**

Wrong: I want to learn how to migrate to Trellix Endpoint Security

Right: Trellix Endpoint Security migration

**Use quotation marks to find a specific phrase:**

“migrate to Trellix Endpoint Security”

**Use sets of quotation marks to search for multiple queries:**

“endpoint security” “Windows”

**Punctuation and special characters are ignored:**

Avoid these characters: `, ~, :, @, #, $, %, ^, &, =, +, <, >, (, )

**The search engine is not case sensitive:**

Endpoint security, endpoint security, and ENDPOINT SECURITY will all yield the same results.

CyberThreat Report

Trellix intelligence connects signals and contextualizes data across security controls to
anticipate, prepare for, and prevent attacks.

### Operational Threat Intelligence

AI-driven ecosystem optimizes workflows to accelerate and scale customer capacity to investigate,
respond to, and recover from incidents.

+

### Automated AI-powered Detection and Response

Trellix unifies protection across complex on-premises, air-gapped, cloud, and operational technology
environments for organizations at all stages of maturity.

+

### Unified Protection for Customer Ecosystems

Resiliency in architecture, management, and operations across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud.

+
